ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly dark (low-intensity) with approximately <5% high-intensity pixel coverage.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single, distinct vertical white linear pixel disruption on the ventral surface of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and ragged tissue margins at both distal tips, indicating substantial physical wear or persistent barnacle colonization.
